# Create parameters for simulation scenarios with different dropout rates 
* use dropout.mid argument in splatter
* use one combination of nbatch and ngroup only => otherwise it gets unnecessarily big

```{r}
facLocs <- c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.3, 0.6)
dparams <- expand.grid(
    batch.facLoc = facLocs, # Strength of batch effect
    de.facLoc = facLocs, # Biological variability
    nbatch = 4, # Number of batches
    ngroup =  4, # Number of cell types
    groupCells = 600, # Number of cells per cell type (adjust as needed)
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    dropout.mid = c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5),
    dropout.shape = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
)
names(dparams)

outdir <- "/local/Projects/AAkalin_Neuroblastoma/Results/simulate_single_cell/h5ad/with_dropout/own_sim"
samplesheet_low_facloc <- dparams %>%
    mutate(sample_name = across(everything(), ~ paste0(cur_column(), .x))) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(sample_name = paste(sample_name, collapse = "_")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(original_h5ad = file.path(outdir, paste0(sample_name, ".h5ad"))) %>%
    select(sample_name, original_h5ad, everything()) %>%
    distinct()
colnames(samplesheet_low_facloc)

samplesheet_low_facloc$file_path <- samplesheet_low_facloc$original_h5ad
# write.table(samplesheet_low_facloc, file = "/local/Projects/AAkalin_Neuroblastoma/Results/simulate_single_cell/h5ad/with_dropout/own_sim/samplesheet_low_facLoc.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

```


# simulation function
```{r}
create_and_save_sim <- function(
    sample_name,
    ngroup,
    nbatch,
    groupCells,
    batch.facLoc,
    de.facLoc,
    outfile = NULL,
    dropout.mid){

    if (!file.exists(outfile)) {
        print(paste0("Processing ", sample_name, " with params:"))
        print(knitr::kable(cbind(ngroup, nbatch, batch.facLoc, de.facLoc, dropout.mid)))
        set.seed(42)
        message("Simulating data")

        sim = splatSimulate(
            batchCells = rep(groupCells * ngroup, nbatch),
            group.prob = rep(1/ngroup, ngroup),
            batch.facLoc = batch.facLoc,
            batch.facScale = 0.1,
            method = "groups",
            verbose = FALSE,
            out.prob    = 0.001,
            de.prob     = 0.1,
            de.facLoc   = de.facLoc,
            de.facScale = 0.1,
            bcv.common  = 0.1,
            dropout.mid = dropout.mid,
            dropout.type = "experiment" # “experiment” is global dropout using the same set of parameters for every cell
        )

        counts <- t(counts(sim)) %>% as.matrix() # for AnnData the matrix is transposed: Gene in columns Cells in rows
        metadata <- colData(sim) %>% as.data.frame()
        var <- rowData(sim) %>% as.data.frame()

        message("Creating AnnData object")
        adata <- anndataR::AnnData(
                            X = counts,
                            obs = metadata,
                            var = var
                        )
        message(paste0("Saving ", outfile))
        anndataR::write_h5ad(adata, path = outfile, mode = "w", compression = "none")
    } else {
        message(paste0(outfile, " already exists. Skipping..."))
    }
}
```

# run and save simulations
```{r}
library(doMC)
registerDoMC(25)
foreach(i = 1:nrow(samplesheet_low_facloc))%dopar%{
    set.seed(42)
    dparam = samplesheet_low_facloc[i,]
    create_and_save_sim(
        dparam$sample_name,
        dparam$ngroup,
        dparam$nbatch,
        dparam$groupCells,
        dparam$batch.facLoc,
        dparam$de.facLoc,
        dparam$original_h5ad,
        dparam$dropout.mid
    )
}
```

# temporary
```{r}
create_and_save_sim_temp <- function(
    sample_name,
    ngroup,
    nbatch,
    groupCells,
    batch.facLoc,
    de.facLoc,
    dropout.mid,
    dropout.shape
    ) {

    print(paste0("Processing ", sample_name, " with params:"))
    print(knitr::kable(cbind(ngroup, nbatch, batch.facLoc, de.facLoc, dropout.mid, dropout.shape)))
    set.seed(42)
    message("Simulating data")

    sim <- splatSimulate(
        batchCells = rep(groupCells * ngroup, nbatch),
        group.prob = rep(1 / ngroup, ngroup),
        batch.facLoc = batch.facLoc,
        batch.facScale = 0.1,
        method = "groups",
        verbose = FALSE,
        out.prob = 0.001,
        de.prob = 0.1,
        de.facLoc = de.facLoc,
        de.facScale = 0.1,
        bcv.common = 0.1,
        dropout.mid = dropout.mid,
        dropout.type = "experiment", # “experiment” is global dropout using the same set of parameters for every cell
        dropout.shape = dropout.shape
    )

    counts <- t(counts(sim)) %>% as.matrix() # for AnnData the matrix is transposed: Gene in columns Cells in rows
    metadata <- colData(sim) %>% as.data.frame()
    var <- rowData(sim) %>% as.data.frame()

    message("Creating AnnData object")
    adata <- anndataR::AnnData(
        X = counts,
        obs = metadata,
        var = var
    )
    return(adata)
}
```

```{r}
adatas <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(filt_params)) {
    set.seed(42)
    dparam <- filt_params[i, ]
    print(dparam)
    adatas[[as.character(dparam$dropout.shape)]] <- create_and_save_sim_temp(
        dparam$sample_name,
        dparam$ngroup,
        dparam$nbatch,
        dparam$groupCells,
        dparam$batch.facLoc,
        dparam$de.facLoc,
        dparam$dropout.mid,
        dparam$dropout.shape
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Define a function to calculate statistics for a given matrix:
calc_stats <- function(adata) {
    mat <- adata$X
    data.frame(
        mean   = mean(mat, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(mat, na.rm = TRUE),
        q25    = quantile(mat, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q75    = quantile(mat, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

# Apply the function to each matrix in the list:
stats_list <- pblapply(adatas, calc_stats, cl = 5)

# Combine the list of data frames into a single data frame:
stats_df <- do.call(rbind, stats_list)
stats_df$k <- rownames(stats_df)
stats_df
stats_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(reorder(k, as.numeric(k)), mean)) +
    geom_point()



```
